devdoc.author: ncitron
devdoc.details: Rebalancing is still not fully trustless, as the operator must act as a price oracle for the tokens  involved in the rebalance and set the trade data. However, a malicious operator can not introduce new  tokens into the rebalance, but can influence the weighting by modifying the inputted price.

params._epochLength: Length of a voting period (in seconds)
params._maxComponents: Maximum number of components in the set
params._minWethLiquidity: Minimum amount of weth liquidity required to add a token
params._startTime: Timestamp for the start of the first voting period

getRebalancePrices().details: This function should only ever be called off-chain since it can be manipulated.

returns.prices: Prices of components in the upcoming rebalance

getSetValue().details: Uses supported exchanges as a price source. This function should only ever be called off-chain since it can be manipulated.

returns._0: Value of set in weth terms

params._voter: Address of voter to check votes for

returns._0: Number of votes that the address has
Array of top voted on components
returns._1: Array of components weights (not units) as per the vote

params._token: Token address to check liquidity for

returns._0: Whether the token is liquid enough

params._status: Boolean indicating if anyone can call trade

params._coolOffPeriods: Array of cool off periods to correct component

params._exchangeData: Array of exchange specific arbitrary bytes data

params._exchangeNames: Array of exchange names mapping to correct component

params._raiseTargetPercentage: Amount to raise all component's unit targets by (in precise units)

params._tradeMaximums: Array of trade maximums mapping to correct component

params._statuses: Booleans indicating if matching trader can trade
params._traders: Array trader addresses to toggle status

startRebalance(uint256,address[],uint256.details: Only operator may call.If the component list does not match the components voted on by the OwlNFT holders this function will revert

params._componentPrices: Component prices of each component in the _component list.
params._components: Component list. Must match the compoennts voted on by OwlNFT holders
params._setValue: Approximate USD value of the index

startRebalanceWithUnits(address[],uint25.details: Overrides the original rebalance function from GIMExtension. Always reverts.

params._status: Boolean indicating whether to allow anyone call

params._callers: Array of caller addresses to toggle status
params._statuses: Array of statuses for each caller

params._components: Array of components that the NFT holder wants added to the index
params._votes: Array of number of votes allocated to each of the components

devdoc.title: ApeRebalanceExtension

getRebalancePrices().notice: Gets the prices for all components that will be involved in the rebalance

getSetValue().notice: Gets the total set value in weth terms

getVotes(address).notice: Fetches the total number of votes of a user. This function allows for an address to hold multiple OwlNFTs.

getWeights().notice: Fetches the current top voted components and weights. When the rebalance begins, it will set the weights to be identical to the weights given by this function. The weights are measured as the percentage of the toal index value, not the unit amounts.

initialize().notice: ONLY OPERATOR: Submits a initialize call to GeneralIndexModule. See GIM for function specific restrictions.

isTokenLiquid(address).notice: Checks whether the token has enough liquidity on a supported exchange to allow it to be added to the set. Must have more than minWethLiquidty weth in the pool.

setAnyoneTrade(bool).notice: ONLY OPERATOR: Submits a setAnyoneTrade call to GeneralIndexModule. See GIM for function specific restrictions.

setCoolOffPeriods(address[],uint256[]).notice: ONLY OPERATOR: Submits a setCoolOffPeriods call to GeneralIndexModule. See GIM for function specific restrictions.

setExchangeData(address[],bytes[]).notice: ONLY OPERATOR: Submits a setExchangeData call to GeneralIndexModule. See GIM for function specific restrictions.

setExchanges(address[],string[]).notice: ONLY OPERATOR: Submits a setExchanges call to GeneralIndexModule. See GIM for function specific restrictions.

setRaiseTargetPercentage(uint256).notice: ONLY OPERATOR: Submits a setRaiseTargetPercentage call to GeneralIndexModule. See GIM for function specific restrictions.

setTradeMaximums(address[],uint256[]).notice: ONLY OPERATOR: Submits a setTradeMaximums call to GeneralIndexModule. See GIM for function specific restrictions.

setTraderStatus(address[],bool[]).notice: ONLY OPERATOR: Submits a setTraderStatus call to GeneralIndexModule. See GIM for function specific restrictions.

updateAnyoneCallable(bool).notice: OPERATOR ONLY: Toggle whether anyone can call function, bypassing the callAllowlist

updateCallerStatus(address[],bool[]).notice: OPERATOR ONLY: Toggle ability for passed addresses to call only allowed caller functions

vote(address[],uint256[]).notice: Submits a vote for an OwlNFT holder. Sum of all votes must not exceed the total votes that the NFT holder has alloted to them. This value can be fetched by calling getVotes on the NFT contract.

userdoc.notice: Rebalance extension that allows NFT holders to vote on token allocations.
